unit_bands.reason: Fifteen logical change units is the review surface one reader can hold at once.
Each band doubles the previous one, so one zone step always means twice the review surface.

risk_floors.reason: A floor keeps a small risky change from reaching AI-only direction approval under staged delivery: R2 needs at least the standing delegate and R3 a human.

line_bump.reason: Beyond this, a reviewer can no longer read every authored line of even a few units in one pass. Black stays black.
